description: Guide sidebar is 216px wide in code vs 253px in design, so the search field, the list, the esc cap and the anchor rail all start about 37px further left
note: [sidebar-width] design is 232px + padding + border (content-box); code is narrower even beyond the box model

description: "What's new" and "About Apiary" are pinned to the bottom of the sidebar in design; in code they flow straight after Message delivery, at the top half of the sidebar
The version is part of the label in code ("What's new 0.4.2" in body type) instead of a right-aligned faint mono "0.4.2"; "About Apiary" uses the normal topic ink instead of the faint colour
Sidebar group labels and topics sit about 6px higher (GUIDE text y≈59 vs 66, Getting started y≈86 vs 92); the group label blocks are spaced differently
Section header reads "THIS PANE" followed by a grey "THIS PANE" pill (the same words twice) instead of "THIS PANE · AGENT RUN"; the pane name "Agent run" is not shown
note: [this-pane-header] code header = section name + this-pane tag; with this data the section name is also This pane

description: The this-pane rows sit in a bordered rounded card (1px #ECEAE5, 8px radius) in design; code has no card, so the rows are flush with the GLOBAL list

Bordered boxes are smaller in code because the design adds borders outside the authored size and code includes them: key caps 18px vs 21px tall (label 1.5px higher), search field 34px vs 36px, footer 34px vs 35px, card 1060×716 vs 1062×718
When a command has several key groups, code puts a faint "·" between the caps (⌥D · ⌥B · ⌥T · ⌥S, e · ⌘⇧E); design spaces the caps 3px apart
Key-cap label ink is lighter in code: #6B6862 (inkSoft) vs #5A564E
The focused search field has a darker border in code (#DAD5CC) than the dialog design shows (--color-border #E7E5E0, although the design paints a caret, i.e. focused)
note: [search-focus-border] the board's own search state uses #DAD5CC

description: Dialog shadow is lighter and tighter in code: 0 16px 40px rgba(40,35,30,.15) vs --shadow-panel 0 24px 64px rgba(40,35,30,.30)
Count reads "22 shortcuts · 10 surfaces" instead of "86 bindings · 10 surfaces"
note: [bindings-count] count is computed from the rendered rows; "bindings" → "shortcuts" wording

description: Footer hints "type to search · ↑↓ move · ↵ run command · esc close" and their separators are missing; only "click keys to rebind" and "live from the command registry" remain
note: [footer-hints] footer copy is hard-coded in the app

description: Active anchor "This pane" is #6F6B63 (600) in code vs primary ink #2E2B27 in design, and "Global" is faint like the rest instead of #6F6B63
Anchor rail is 128px wide vs 163px and its items are spaced 22.7px apart vs 21px
